description: This file contains a React functional component that represents a Figma-based design mockup of a Todo page. It serves as a placeholder or scaffold for the UI components defined in a Figma design, with comments indicating where to implement and replace placeholders with actual components generated from Figma JSON attachments.

methods.name: TodoPageFigma
methods.description: A React functional component serving as a placeholder for the Todo page UI designed in Figma. It includes styled div containers for main sections such as header, footer, list, floating action button, and status bar, with comments indicating where to implement actual components.
